coverage.label: Wednesday 8 July 2026 (plus items since last run, 7 July)

findings.title: Doha Mall reports surging footfall, 30 new brands; launches "Hala Summer" with Visit Qatar 2 Jul 2026
findings.summary: Doha Mall (Al Mirqab Malls Company) reported footfall up 73% during Eid Al-Fitr and 97% during Eid Al-Adha versus prior periods, with 30 new brands opened in recent months (Vodafone, Stradale Motors, Solitaire, Mlameh, first Qatar location) and 100+ stores now trading. A three-month "Hala Summer" campaign with Visit Qatar runs July–September 2026. Qatar's largest Homes R Us store is among upcoming openings. GM Hakan Altin quoted.

findings.title: Foreign real-estate ownership zones open: Qiddiya, New Murabba, Jabal Omar included 24–30 Jun 2026
findings.summary: The Saudi Cabinet approved geographic zones where non-Saudis may own property, including MECSR member destinations Qiddiya and New Murabba (Riyadh) and Jabal Omar (Makkah; Muslims only for the holy cities). The Saudi Properties platform is accepting applications. Listed property stocks rallied on the news (MASAR +10% limit-up, 24 Jun). Long-term demand implication for retail components of these giga-projects.

findings.title: Primark confirms Qatar and Bahrain debuts by end-2026 date unverified
findings.summary: Primark's GCC rollout continues: first Qatar store at Doha Festival City and first Bahrain store at City Centre Bahrain, both due by end-2026, following its regional debut at The Avenues Kuwait (Oct 2025). Anchor-signing relevance for both member malls.

findings.title: Dubai pipeline: Sobha Mall and Liwan Mall both slated for H2 2026 date unverified
findings.summary: Among seven UAE malls tracked for 2026 openings: Sobha Mall (AED 210m, Sobha Hartland, 339,000 sq ft built-up, 115,000 sq ft GLA, ~35 outlets) and Liwan Mall (Wadi Al Safa 2) are both due in H2 2026. Candidates for directory addition on opening confirmation.

findings.title: Five new AVMs (~212,000 sqm) to open by end-2026 date unverified
findings.summary: New shopping centres are scheduled in Istanbul, Ankara, Muğla, Elazığ and Düzce, totalling roughly 212,000 sqm, continuing the shift of AVM investment toward Anatolian cities. Türkiye's malls generated ~$55bn revenue in 2024. Retail confidence index at 115.9; JPMorgan expects sector earnings recovery in 2026.

findings.title: Oman Avenues Mall adds new Centrepoint anchor date unverified
findings.summary: Oman Avenues Mall (Muscat) expanded its retail mix with an all-new Centrepoint store (Landmark Group brand, also a MECSR member connection). Anchor refresh strengthens the mall's fashion and home offering.

findings.title: Context items >90 days
findings.summary: Aldar–Mubadala AED 10bn retail JV (Yas Mall + The Galleria) completed Feb 2026, backdrop to Abu Dhabi retail consolidation ( Mubadala · Feb 2026 ). Iraq Mall, Baghdad (550,000 sqm, Iraq's largest) opened Feb 2026; Zara, Nike, Spinneys now trading ( Iraqi News · 2026 ). Mall of the Emirates AED 5bn transformation announced 16 Apr 2025; four entertainment offerings and new IMAX due late 2026 ( MAF · 16 Apr 2025 ).

findings.title: MEMBER NEWS Seef Properties: update on GFH voluntary offer discussions ~7–8 Jul 2026 Deal / JV
findings.summary: A new disclosure, "Update on Discussions Regarding a Voluntary Offer for a Number of the Issued Shares of Seef Properties B.S.C.", was posted to the DFM disclosure feed on or about 7 July 2026 (feed shows "2 days ago"; exact timestamp not machine-readable, date approximate). Background: GFH Financial Group (~30% shareholder) proposed a voluntary takeover of a portion of Seef shares in May 2026, subject to regulatory, board and shareholder approvals. Seef shares closed at BHD 0.126 on 8 July, up from 0.120, consistent with renewed offer momentum. Seef Properties is a Priority 1 member; also monitor alongside its Seef Mall revamp plan.

findings.title: MEMBER NEWS City Centre Bahrain (Majid Al Futtaim) launches summer raffle campaign from 8 Jul 2026 Campaign
findings.summary: City Centre Bahrain's summer promotion runs 8 July – 31 August 2026: shoppers spending BD 30+ enter a grand raffle including a Toyota Prado, with a "Summer Surprises Activation" at the Central Galleria from 8 July – 8 August. Campaign start date falls inside the coverage window; the mall is also Primark's confirmed Bahrain entry point by end-2026.

sources.label: City Centre Bahrain (official) · campaign live 8 Jul 2026

findings.title: MEMBER NEWS Cenomi Retail EGA concludes; Cenomi Centers combination talks suspended 1 Jul 2026 Financial
findings.summary: AFG International Co. (Cenomi Retail) announced results of its Extraordinary General Assembly held 30 June 2026 (64.09% quorum). Separately, Saudi Exchange filings show discussions on a potential Cenomi Centers–Cenomi Retail combination have been suspended until further notice . Cenomi Centers (Priority 1 member) otherwise continues its Westfield partnership rollout (up to 20 years, 50+ exclusive concepts) and has an international sukuk maturing 7 Oct 2026 slated for full redemption.

findings.title: MEMBER NEWS Lulu Group: QR500m Qatar push: three new hypermarkets; 50 GCC stores by 2028 late Jun 2026 New Project
findings.summary: Lulu Group International (member: Lulu International Holdings) will invest QR500m (~$137m) in three Qatar hypermarkets at Baraha Town, Al Waab and Qetaifan Island, opening within 8–10 months. Baraha Town (Q1 2027) is billed as Qatar's largest fully air-conditioned retail/residential/office destination. Group-wide, Lulu Retail plans 50 new stores across UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and Bahrain in 2026–28; its Happiness loyalty programme passed 1 million members.

findings.title: MEMBER NEWS Line Investments & Property wraps Summer Super Sale across 12 malls 2 Jul 2026 Campaign
findings.summary: Priority 1 member Line Investments & Property (Lulu Group's mall arm) reported a successful Summer Super Sale, 4–28 June 2026, across its 12 malls in Abu Dhabi, Al Ain and Al Dhafra, a portfolio-scale footfall driver heading into DSS season.
